rule.title: Interest received as a nominee for another person is subtracted

when_missing.because: Interest on the recipient's own form is theirs unless a preparer says they received it as a nominee

citation.wording: Subtract that amount from the interest income subtotal.

rule.open_point: Only the whole form is answered: a PART received as a nominee is an amount a person states, and no operator reduces a figure by an answered amount.
